description: This file defines a validation pipeline behavior for MediatR in an ASP.NET Core application, utilizing FluentValidation to validate requests before processing.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior that intercepts MediatR requests to perform validation using registered FluentValidation validators.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the request, performs validation, and either throws an exception if validation fails or proceeds to the next delegate.
